purpose: Test whether frozen V6.6 GPI/IPI levels, trajectory, and one policy starting-point variable contain stable continuous information about the next 6-month Fed policy move.

A1_public_feed_screening.source: existing repo public_data.py mapping + frozen V6.6 Python mirror
A1_public_feed_screening.interpretation: screening only; public Yahoo/FRED feeds are not claimed vendor-identical to TradingView

A2_tradingview_feed_confirmation.note: Issue #59 established Pine↔Python formula parity on same TradingView history, not public-feed identity.

policy_starting_point.name: real_policy_rate
policy_starting_point.reason: Conservative monthly availability rule; no real-time vintage claim.

monthly_sampling.gpi_ipi: last available daily observation in calendar month m
monthly_sampling.trajectory: computed on daily V6.6 raw axes before month-end sampling

estimation.zero_std_policy: drop no feature dynamically; fail closed if a training feature has zero variance
estimation.coefficient_information_rule: training row is eligible only when its 6M policy outcome would already be known before the current forecast origin
estimation.training_origin_cutoff_rule: For forecast origin m with H=6, training origins must be <= m-(H+1) months, so their full 6M outcome is known strictly before m.
estimation.minimum_complete_training_rows_reason: At least four observations per M2 feature before OOS estimation; engineering guard only, fixed before outcomes.
estimation.comparison_sample_policy: M0/M1/M2 use the same complete-case rows: all M2 features and the primary 6M outcome must be finite for both training and evaluation.

directional_diagnostic.metric: sign agreement on observations with abs(realized 6M change) > 0.25pp

phase_A_decision_rules.continuous_policy_information_stable: M2 improves primary OOS error versus M1, does not materially degrade directional diagnostics, and the improvement is not isolated to only one predeclared temporal segment. A1 alone is still screening and requires A2 confirmation.
phase_A_decision_rules.levels_and_stance_sufficient_dynamics_ad: M1 improves over M0 but M2 does not provide stable incremental value over M1.
phase_A_decision_rules.modern_policy_relation_period_dependent: Useful full-sample relation exists but incremental signs/performance materially reverse or concentrate in one temporal segment.
phase_A_decision_rules.no_useful_policy_information: Neither stance nor trajectory produces useful OOS information over M0.
phase_A_decision_rules.inconclusive_short_sample: Effective OOS sample or period counts are too small/conflicting to classify defensibly.

forbidden: 10Y real yield as extra policy input
promoting 3M or 12M horizon because it looks better
production Policy Pressure line before A2 confirmation
